% E2E canonical fixture #3 — multipage.
% Enough paragraphs in a short body to force >=2 NATURAL page breaks
% (no \eject). Pins page-builder break decisions and the per-page folio
% (headline/footline via plain.tex \pageno). Each paragraph is a single
% short line so the break count is governed purely by \vsize accounting.
\hsize=4in
\vsize=72pt
\noindent Paragraph one.\par
\noindent Paragraph two.\par
\noindent Paragraph three.\par
\noindent Paragraph four.\par
\noindent Paragraph five.\par
\noindent Paragraph six.\par
\noindent Paragraph seven.\par
\noindent Paragraph eight.\par
\bye
